lines: The Workshop District. The clang of hammers and the hiss of soldering fills the air. Workbenches line the walls, covered in tools and half-finished projects.
The smell of hot metal and solder — the smell of things being made.
Yun takes the materials and lays them out on the workbench. 'Good. Let me show you how this works.'
'The Umbracite forms the energy matrix. The copper coils distribute the charge. When you get Stabilizing Resin from your homestead plants, you'll have everything you need.'
'For now, I'll put these toward your first battery. Come back with the resin when your homestead is producing.'
'And one more thing — the Array could make these batteries themselves. They choose not to. Ask yourself why an all-powerful automated system wants humanity dependent on them for power.'

actions.text: A calibration wrench with 'DAVI' scratched into the handle. Someone's looking for this.

lines: Davi's face lights up. 'My wrench! You're a lifesaver!'
'Here — take these Copper Coils. I was saving them, but you need them more than I do.'

actions.prompt: Yun inspects your Stabilizing Resin. 'You've got the last ingredient. Ready to build your first rechargeable battery?'

options.label: Craft Battery
options.description: Use Stabilizing Resin to complete the battery (Umbracite and Copper Coils were provided earlier).

lines: Yun works with practiced efficiency. The resin is heated, shaped, and pressed around the energy matrix you prepared earlier.
'There she is. Holds a charge, releases it clean. Better than those disposable cells you've been burning through.'
'You're self-sufficient now. That's rare. Most Lightkeepers burn through cells and come begging for more.'
'The Array could teach anyone to make these. They don't. They want you dependent. Remember that.'

actions.prompt: Yun nods at your materials. 'Another battery? I can show you the process again.'

options.label: Craft Battery
options.description: Use 1x Umbracite, 1x Copper Coil, 1x Stabilizing Resin.

actions.text: Yun guides you through another battery assembly. 'You're getting the hang of it. Soon you won't need me at all.'

lines: Yun studies you with an appraising look. 'You've got steady hands. Let's see if you can handle something harder.'
'I want you to craft a Modified Battery Casing. Take a Chitin Plate — you'll need one from a Nest Mother — and a Copper Coil. Shape them together.'
'Bring me the finished casing and I'll use it to upgrade your Sol Unit. Extended energy capacity. Permanent improvement.'

actions.prompt: You have the materials for Yun's challenge. Craft a Modified Battery Casing?

options.label: Craft Casing
options.description: Use 1x Chitin Plate + 1x Copper Coil to craft the Modified Battery Casing.

actions.text: You shape the chitin plate around the copper coil framework. The result is a reinforced battery housing — lighter and stronger than standard materials.

lines: Yun takes the casing, turning it over in his hands. A rare smile crosses his face.
'Clean work. Very clean. This'll integrate directly into your Sol Unit's power system.'
He fits the casing into your Sol Unit with a series of precise adjustments. You feel the energy capacity expand.
'Twenty percent more capacity. Permanent. That's the difference between a craftsman and a consumer.'
'And here's something to think about: the Array could teach anyone to make these. They don't. They want you dependent on their energy supply. Independence is a threat to them.'

actions.prompt: Yun notices you have the materials. 'I heard about Sera's mite problem. I can build a Sonic Repeller from a Copper Coil if you want.'

options.label: Craft Repeller
options.description: Use 1x Copper Coil to build a Sonic Repeller.

options.label: No thanks
options.description: Maybe you'll buy one from Mira instead.

actions.text: Yun rigs a small ultrasonic emitter from the copper coil. 'Simple device. Mites hate the frequency. Give it to Sera and her crops will be fine.'
